Server-Sent Events stream for real-time odds and opportunity updates. Requires streaming access (WebSocket add-on, Enterprise tier, or active trial).

Use `api_key` query parameter for authentication since `EventSource` cannot set headers.

## Channels

| Channel | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `opportunities` | EV, arbitrage, middles, low-hold updates (default) |
| `odds` | Raw odds changes |
| `all` | Both odds and opportunities |
| `gamestate` | Live game state updates (Enterprise only) |

## Event Types

| Event | Payload | Description |
|-------|---------|-------------|
| `connected` | `{filters, channels}` | Stream established |
| `snapshot` | Array of items | Initial data dump (one per type) |
| `snapshot:complete` | `{}` | All snapshots sent |
| `odds:update` | `Odds` | Odds changed |
| `odds:removed` | `{id, sportsbook}` | Selection removed |
| `ev:detected` | `{opportunities: EVOpportunity[], count, type}` | New or updated +EV opportunities |
| `ev:expired` | `{expired: id[], count, type}` | EV opportunities gone |
| `arb:detected` | `{opportunities: ArbitrageOpportunity[], count, type}` | New or updated arbitrage |
| `arb:expired` | `{expired: id[], count, type}` | Arbitrage gone |
| `middles:detected` | `{opportunities: MiddleOpportunity[], count, type}` | New or updated middles |
| `middles:expired` | `{expired: id[], count, type}` | Middles gone |
| `low_hold:detected` | `{opportunities: LowHoldOpportunity[], count, type}` | New or updated low-hold |
| `low_hold:expired` | `{expired: id[], count, type}` | Low-hold gone |
| `gamestate:snapshot` | `{sport, events}` | Initial game state |
| `gamestate:update` | `{sport, event_id, ...}` | Game state changed |
| `heartbeat` | `{ts}` | Keep-alive (every 30s) |
| `error` | `{message}` | Recoverable error |

A `:detected` event carries new opportunities **and** updated versions of ones already sent: since 2026-09-26, an opportunity whose content changes (price, EV%, fair probability, leg odds, `is_suspended`, `quality_tier`) is re-sent under the same `id`. Upsert by `id`, and treat only an `id` you have not seen as new.

Supports `Last-Event-ID` header for reconnection.

data.current_description:
Server-Sent Events stream for real-time odds and opportunity updates. Requires streaming access (WebSocket add-on, Enterprise tier, or active trial).

Use `api_key` query parameter for authentication since `EventSource` cannot set headers.

## Channels

| Channel | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `opportunities` | EV, arbitrage, middles, low-hold updates (default) |
| `odds` | Raw odds changes |
| `all` | Both odds and opportunities |
| `gamestate` | Live game state updates (Enterprise only) |

## Event Types

| Event | Payload | Description |
|-------|---------|-------------|
| `connected` | `{filters, channels}` | Stream established |
| `snapshot` | Array of items | Initial data dump (one per type) |
| `snapshot:complete` | `{}` | All snapshots sent |
| `odds:update` | `Odds` | Odds changed |
| `odds:removed` | `{id, sportsbook}` | Selection removed |
| `ev:detected` | `{opportunities: EVOpportunity[], count, type}` | New or updated +EV opportunities |
| `ev:expired` | `{expired: id[], count, type}` | EV opportunities gone |
| `arb:detected` | `{opportunities: ArbitrageOpportunity[], count, type}` | New or updated arbitrage |
| `arb:expired` | `{expired: id[], count, type}` | Arbitrage gone |
| `middles:detected` | `{opportunities: MiddleOpportunity[], count, type}` | New or updated middles |
| `middles:expired` | `{expired: id[], count, type}` | Middles gone |
| `low_hold:detected` | `{opportunities: LowHoldOpportunity[], count, type}` | New or updated low-hold |
| `low_hold:expired` | `{expired: id[], count, type}` | Low-hold gone |
| `gamestate:snapshot` | `{sport, events}` | Initial game state |
| `gamestate:update` | `{sport, event_id, ...}` | Game state changed |
| `heartbeat` | `{ts}` | Keep-alive (every 30s) |
| `error` | `{message}` | Recoverable error |

A `:detected` event carries new opportunities **and** updated versions of ones already sent: since 2026-09-26, an opportunity whose content changes (price, EV%, fair probability, leg odds, `is_suspended`, `quality_tier`) is re-sent under the same `id`. Upsert by `id`, and treat only an `id` you have not seen as new.

Supports `Last-Event-ID` header for reconnection.
